hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the latent binary kernel T(u,v) at (u,v)=(i,j). The identity operator gives T(i,j); the argument permutation operator gives T(j,i). The raw expression is the sum of these two operator images, i.e. the symmetrization S[T](i,j)=T(i,j)+T(j,i).
required_assumptions: T(i,j) and T(j,i) are well-formed terms over the same argument domain
hypotheses.rationale: The expression is structurally the sum of a binary term and its swapped-argument counterpart, so the latent object is the unsymmetrized binary kernel T(u,v) together with the two-element permutation action; the sum is the invariant symmetrization.
